notes.title: Dev Diary #7
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 
It’s been a while! We hope you are doing well! Here is the update for the month:

-Alternate skins? We’ve been experimenting with the idea. Would you like to have different appearances for Alice?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/53dd75a4ff916f8162ccd317471b0cc483b0914a.png[/img]

-We’ve finished integrating the Hatter and we’ve made a room for him, which will serve as a recurrent safe haven to rest and adjust your build, among other things.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/1139d52a0fba9432e363ff6d62f6026076a552ad.gif[/img]

-Getting it ready for you all to go down the rabbit hole.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/ce102d83a399355d403ae29b0fa54b377d25cc26.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoyed the new content, we’ll keep doing our best to make the game even better.
Be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Team_Lunarians]X[/url] and wishlist on Steam if you haven’t! It helps us a lot!
See you in the next Dev Diary!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/98f15f5faf8dcc3cc58a10563fdac13aa7c254be.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/834e6019adc1a5c5e4cd286f3eb629ca0955082c.gif[/img]

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Team_Lunarians]X[/url] and wishlist on Steam if you haven’t! It helps us a lot!

notes.title: Dev Diary #4
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

This month we have been hard at work with the Rose boss. We’ve made good progress with its logic and attacks and have polished its visuals to make it easily readable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/047c45378f024908f0f3582a23a182349a388cc2.gif[/img]

Talking about visuals, we have added animation and vfx to the healing ability. We are drawing inspiration from alchemy to make these spells, so each one of them will have an alchemical symbol associated with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/92749214d99f4b7a1d23bfbee47d5504cbc94534.gif[/img]

That’s all for now. Remember to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Team_Lunarians]Twitter/X[/url] for more updates and to give us your opinion as we go. We really value your feedback.
You can also help us by adding the game to your wishlist!
See you next month!

notes.title: Dev Diary #3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This month, we have both continued to update more of Alice animations, and we have also worked on the scenery more specifically, the first boss room!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/e817c32283158024ade43fffabc65c4cf1eedfdc.gif[/img]

It feels better to jump about now. What do you think? You can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Team_Lunarians]Twitter[/url] and tell us. We are always eager to listen to your feedback.

As for the first boss. We have been working on the mood around it. Without getting into much detail, the boss is a mysterious entity in the shape of a rose, that will test your might against its guardian, a disembodied hand of thorns.
Here is some concept art, and the current version in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/ca8cf7feeea69d902b7bc693190faf89f32a9111.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/d1c9b83317ab1e7fba6517417c2a7597350edd3c.png[/img]

We want to create  a feel of uneasiness, so we’ve been working with rim lights and Unity’s 2D lights.



That was all for today. But a little something might be coming for Spooktober too…

Stick around if you want to see more of the development, and don’t forget to check our [url=https://twitter.com/Team_Lunarians]Twitter[/url]!

See you in the next update!

notes.title: Dev Diary #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This month, we have made progress with different Alice abilities, and we have improved older systems.
One of those systems is magic. Now you can equip up to four spells and easily cast them through spell shortcuts. There’s a big variety of spells to pick from, so have fun looking for your favorite combination!

Another update goes to the “Drink Me” ability, the first ability Alice finds in her adventure.
We have updated the visuals to make it look smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/c958c7e7138e27a925b3a68e63180fcd49ce9a71.gif[/img]

We have also added a lot of smaller updates, but we want to keep these announcements brief, so we will say goodbye with a picture of Alice’s main weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/d5a8403b0c20b34a75476fe693eaf664df80ae09.png[/img]

If you want to see more, you can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Team_Lunarians]Twitter! [/url]
See you on the next Dev Diary!

notes.title: Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are back with another monthly update.
At last, we are approaching the culmination of the tea springs area, and only a few more rooms are left unfinished.
Here is one of our latest set pieces for it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/0823cbd40e46b6bfb49ef7d2aaa3336239ecb5d7.gif[/img]

To add some more variety, we are also adding a new type of enemy to the other aberrant fauna you may find down in the caves. 
This poor rat has been parasitized by one of the strange roses invading the cave, and is wandering mindlessly to find new hosts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/199670bea5b71377702c64f748bc438f29a3236a.gif[/img]

It may not have the best sight, but don’t get caught by those tendrils, its thorns are excruciatingly sharp.

We have also been putting some work into Alice’s magic system. We are saving it for the next update, but we are making sure that spell casting feels agile, varied, and satisfying.
Almost as satisfying as opening an unbirthday present.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/a33d0fca4eea3b5b257799f38974928bf558b364.gif[/img]

See you in the next devlog,
Team Lunarians

notes.title: Dev Diary #0
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Firstly, we want to express our gratitude to everyone who has wishlisted the game so far. Your support motivates us greatly and fuels our motivation to create a game that all metroidvania fans can enjoy!

Since we made our Steam page public in late March, we have been working non-stop, and we're excited to share with you our progress and our vision for the near and future developments.

Our primary focus has been finishing one of the first areas, the subterranean tea springs. This is where the villagers from above collect tea from a well.
Currently, the area is being overtaken by a mysterious rose vine plant, and its thorns will provide a dangerous obstacle to overcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/f96cc12b8070d4d1ee51cb2c50cba0ba5865b37c.png[/img]

At the same time, we have been refining the game’s mechanics, finishing up a few systems and drafting item descriptions and story material.

Our Twitter community has been an important source of feedback, helping us improve our game and designs. We're grateful for all the suggestions and support!

We want the game to look the best it can, and the most attentive of you may have noticed that we have removed or replaced some of our old Steam screenshots. That's because we're giving them a much needed facelift.  We can’t wait to show you the new and improved look of those areas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43861627/fa7a850780947c5b771d465ef786e9125ed743a2.png[/img]

The entire Steam page is also undergoing a steady transformation. Our next steps include adding gameplay gifs to the description and eventually releasing a [b]trailer[/b].

We will be posting more of these Devlogs in the future, as we want to be as transparent as possible with you, so stay tuned for future updates, and please keep the feedback coming! We love hearing your opinions!

See you on the next dev diary,
Javier and Violett (Team Lunarians)

P.S. Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Team_Lunarians] Twitter [/url] if you want to see more frequent updates, we post new stuff twice a week!
